01绿色航运与脱碳 · 2026年11月23日

COP31谈判破裂，航运净零框架谈判迎来关键一周

COP31 Collapse Casts Shadow over Shipping's Net-Zero Showdown

Climate talks in Antalya ended without an overarching deal after nearly 200 countries failed to bridge divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance. As IMO delegates resume technical talks in London ahead of MEPC 85, shipping's Net-Zero Framework remains divided over its economic element, with the US opposing mandatory emissions charges. Shipping still left Antalya with voluntary pledges, including backing for electricity to supply at least 20% of international shipping's final energy demand by 2035.

COP31 安塔利亚峰会周日无果而终，近 200 个国家未能就化石燃料与气候资金弥合分歧，欧盟、英国和岛国拒绝了未提及逐步淘汰煤炭、石油和天然气的《安塔利亚契约》。与此同时，国际海事组织（IMO）本周在伦敦重启技术讨论，为下周的海洋环境保护委员会（MEPC 85）做准备，航运净零框架的经济要素仍存重大分歧，美国反对强制性排放收费。尽管 COP31 未达成总体协议，航运业仍获得自愿承诺，30 多个组织支持到 2035 年电力占国际航运最终能源需求至少 20% 的目标。

19绿色航运与脱碳 · 2026年11月23日

AET 混合动力驳运船完成改装，纯电续航 500 海里

AET and Fleetzero Bring Hybrid-Electric Lightering Vessel to Life

Singapore-based tanker owner AET has completed the hybrid-electric conversion of its lightering support vessel AET Innovator, set to be unveiled in New Orleans on 1 December for ship-to-ship lightering operations in the US Gulf. Touted as the world's longest-range plug-in hybrid-electric ship, it has an estimated all-electric range of 500 nautical miles and a hybrid range of 13,500 nautical miles, with propulsion fuel and maintenance costs expected to fall by up to 49% and tank-to-wake greenhouse gas emissions by about 82%.

新加坡油轮船东 AET 完成驳运支援船 AET Innovator 号的混合动力改装，将于 12 月 1 日在新奥尔良亮相，部署于美国墨西哥湾的船对船驳运作业。该船被称作全球续航最长的插电式混合动力船舶，纯电续航约 500 海里，混合动力续航 13,500 海里；改装以约 11 兆瓦时磷酸铁锂电池替代两座柴油舱，预计油耗与维护成本最多降低 49%，油箱到尾气（tank-to-wake）温室气体排放减少约 82%。

霍尔木兹海峡航运骤减，周末仅五艘商船通过

Hormuz Shipping Slows Sharply After Tanker Attacks

Commercial transits through the Strait of Hormuz slowed dramatically over the weekend, with Kpler recording five commodity vessels on Saturday and none on Sunday, against 31 the previous weekend. The slowdown followed attacks on tankers, including vessels operated by Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, heightening security concerns in the waterway linking the Gulf with global energy markets.

路透社援引 Kpler 船舶追踪数据报道，霍尔木兹海峡的商业通行上周末急剧放缓，周六仅五艘商品船通过，周日为零，而此前一个周末为 31 艘。此前一周，阿联酋称阿布扎比国家石油公司的船只在过境时遇袭，油轮遇袭加剧了对这条全球能源咽喉要道的安全担忧。

No Safe Harbour as Maritime War Spreads Beyond Black Sea

The maritime war between Russia and Ukraine has expanded far beyond the Black Sea: the Russian corvette Merkury was struck by suspected sea drones at Benghazi, Libya, catching fire before capsizing alongside the quay, while a Maltese-flagged merchant vessel was hit nearby the same day. A day earlier, the US-sanctioned Russian cargo ship Sparta II was attacked by drones in the Gulf of Finland, forcing the evacuation of all 16 crew.

俄罗斯拨款 5.76 亿美元建造渡轮，保障加里宁格勒补给

Russia to Spend $576 Million on Ferries to Secure Supplies to Kaliningrad

Russia will spend 47 billion roubles ($576 million) to build two giant rail ferries to ensure uninterrupted supplies to its Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad, Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin said on Monday. The ferries are expected to enter service in 2030 between Ust-Luga and Baltiysk. Maritime shipping now carries over half of the exclave's supplies, up from 8% in 2021.

俄罗斯总理米舒斯京周一表示，俄罗斯将斥资 470 亿卢布（约 5.76 亿美元）建造两艘巨型铁路渡轮，确保飞地加里宁格勒的物资供应不中断，两船预计 2030 年投入运营，往返于乌斯季卢加港与波罗的斯克之间。报道称，海运目前承担加里宁格勒一半以上的补给，而 2021 年仅为 8%，约 30 艘船参与运输。

搁浅散货船面临复杂打捞，法国海岸风暴中锚链被拖断

Grounded Bulker Faces Complex Salvage Operation off French Coast

French authorities are preparing a difficult salvage operation to free a 28,200 dwt bulk carrier driven onto an Atlantic beach during a storm. The 2011-built, Malta-flagged Miro G grounded early on Friday at Cap de l'Homy after 48-knot gusts dragged its anchors, while sailing in ballast from Santander to Rouen. French air force helicopters evacuated 19 of the 22 seafarers, and failed generators and shallow water are hampering efforts to pull the vessel clear.

法国当局正准备对一艘在风暴中被冲上大西洋海滩的 28,200 载重吨散货船实施艰难打捞。2011 年建造、马耳他籍的 Miro G 号上周五凌晨在法国西南部利特-米克斯附近搁浅，48 节阵风拖断了锚链，该船当时正空载从桑坦德驶往鲁昂。法国空军直升机周五撤离了船上 22 名海员中的 19 人，两台主机发电机均无法使用，浅水使拖带作业更加困难。

06港口与供应链 · 2026年11月23日

新加坡大士港二期动工，21 个深水泊位 2028 年起陆续投运

Singapore Accelerates Port Automation with Tuas Phase Two Expansion

PSA Singapore broke ground on 20 November on the second phase of Tuas Port, adding 21 deepwater berths at 23 m water depth along 8.6 km of wharf, with operations starting progressively from 2028. Phase Two will expand automation and AI capabilities, deploying close to 1,000 autonomous, AI-enabled intelligent guided vehicles. Once all four phases are complete in the 2040s, Tuas Port is planned to have 66 mega berths and about 65 million TEU of annual capacity.

新加坡港务集团（PSA）11 月 20 日为大士港二期举行了动工仪式，二期将新增 21 个水深 23 米的深水泊位、8.6 公里码头岸线，2028 年起陆续投运，全部泊位预计 2030 年代中期投入使用。二期将扩大自动化与人工智能应用，投运后将部署近 1,000 辆自动驾驶智能导引车；大士港全部四期建成后将拥有 66 个大型泊位，年处理能力约 6,500 万标准箱。

印度航运公司 32 亿美元招标 22 艘船，力推本土造船

Shipping Corp of India Casts $3.2bn Net for 22 Ships

State-owned Shipping Corporation of India is pressing ahead with a fleet expansion worth an estimated $3.2bn, tendering for up to 22 newbuildings across gas carriers, tankers and containers, alongside a separate push for secondhand tonnage. The package covers eight 88,000 cu m very large gas carriers worth about $950m, six 18,000 TEU containerships, up to six 8,000 TEU boxships and two 155,000 dwt suezmax tankers, with requirements for part of the work to be built in India.

印度国有航运公司（SCI）正推进约 32 亿美元的船队扩张，招标建造多达 22 艘新船，涵盖气体船、油轮和集装箱船，并另行寻求二手吨位。招标包括八艘 88,000 立方米超大型气体船（合计约 9.5 亿美元，2027 年 1 月 27 日截标）、六艘 18,000 标准箱集装箱船、最多六艘 8,000 标准箱集装箱船和两艘 155,000 载重吨苏伊士型油轮。招标要求部分船舶在印度建造，以吸引外国船厂技术落户印度。

Singapore Shipping Returns to Newbuilds with $210m Car Carrier Deal

Singapore Shipping Corporation has returned to the newbuilding market with a $210m investment in two LNG dual-fuel car carriers at Guangzhou Shipyard International, due for delivery in March and June 2031. The shipbuilding contracts total $187m, or $93.5m per vessel. It is SSC's first newbuilding move in more than a decade, with around 80% of its existing car carrier fleet approaching the end of its economic life, and further orders of up to four ships worth as much as $400m may follow.

新加坡航运公司（SSC）与广州广船国际和中国船舶工业贸易公司签约，订造两艘 7,000 车位 LNG 双燃料汽车运输船，分别于 2031 年 3 月和 6 月交付，造船合同总价 1.87 亿美元、单船 9,350 万美元，计入融资等费用后总投资约 2.1 亿美元。这是该公司十多年来首次订造新船，其现有五艘汽车船中四艘建于 1999 至 2004 年，约 80% 的船舶接近经济寿命末期；后续还可能再订最多四艘，总额可达 4 亿美元。

Precious Shipping Secures Year-Long Ultramax Charter

Thailand's Precious Shipping has secured another index-linked ultramax charter with Singapore's PACC Line, fixing the 2015-built Sarita Naree for up to 13 months at a current equivalent rate of around $23,700 per day. 泰国 Precious Shipping 与新加坡 PACC Line 再签一份指数挂钩的超灵便型船期租合同，2015 年建造的 Sarita Naree 号（62,964 载重吨）自 11 月 22 日起执行 11 至 13 个月租约，租金相当于波罗的海超灵便型指数 BSI-63K 前 15 天加权平均期租费率的 103%，当前折合日租金约 23,700 美元。这是该公司近期一连串指数挂钩租约中的最新一单。

Jinhui Finds New Buyer for Supramax at Higher Price

Hong Kong-based dry bulk owner Jinhui Shipping and Transportation has found a new buyer for its 2012-built supramax Jin Bi, securing $17.8m from Singapore-based Global Pacific Shipping, with delivery scheduled between 25 November and 30 December. An earlier $14.4m sale agreed in December 2025 was cancelled, and the new deal is $3.4m higher with full payment before delivery; Jinhui expects a gain of about $5.2m on the sale.

香港干散货船东金辉航运为 2012 年建造的超灵便型船 Jin Bi 号找到了新买家，与新加坡 Global Pacific Shipping 签署谅解备忘录，售价 1,780 万美元，2026 年 11 月 25 日至 12 月 30 日间交付。金辉今年早些时候曾以 1,440 万美元达成出售协议但因交船条件未能满足而取消，新协议售价高出 340 万美元，且买方须在交船前付清全款；按 9 月底账面价值 1,260 万美元计算，预计录得约 520 万美元收益。

Aegean Shipping Adds Fresh Tanker Pair at COSCO Yard

Gulf Energy Maritime Doubles Down on LR1s in South Korea

Dubai-based tanker owner Gulf Energy Maritime has signed up for another series of LR1 product tanker newbuildings at South Korea's K Shipbuilding, extending its investment in the panamax segment. Vår Energi 44 亿美元收购康菲石油挪威业务，产量将达约 55 万桶油当量/日

Vår Energi Snaps Up ConocoPhillips' North Sea Business in $4.4bn Deal

Norwegian oil and gas producer Vår Energi has agreed to acquire ConocoPhillips' Norwegian upstream business and associated infrastructure in Norway and the UK in a deal valued at $4.425bn. The transaction includes operatorship of the Greater Ekofisk Area, the Norpipe export pipeline system and the Teesside terminal, with interests in 13 producing fields holding about 414m barrels of oil equivalent in proven and probable reserves. Pro forma production is expected to reach around 550,000 boepd.

挪威油气生产商 Vår Energi 同意以 44.25 亿美元收购康菲石油的挪威上游业务及挪威与英国相关基础设施，包括大埃科菲斯克地区（Greater Ekofisk Area）的作业权、Norpipe 出口管道系统和英国 Teesside 终端。收购资产包括 13 个在产油田的权益，约 4.14 亿桶油当量证实加概算储量；交易预计 2027 年第一季度末完成，完成后 Vår Energi 备考产量将达约 55 万桶油当量/日。

Russian LNG to Turkey Must Sail Through the Mediterranean

Russian LNG tankers bound for Turkey must cross the Mediterranean, which all 25 Arctic LNG 2 cargoes to China avoided, Urgewald said on 23 November, citing Kpler shipping data. Eleven cargoes that left between 1 November 2025 and 16 February 2026 went through the Mediterranean and Suez, while all 25 that left between 25 February and 19 August 2026 sailed around the Cape of Good Hope, after the Arctic Metagaz was hit by explosions near Malta on 3 March.

据 Urgewald 援引 Kpler 航运数据分析，俄罗斯北极 LNG 2 项目自 2026 年 2 月 25 日至 8 月 19 日发往中国的全部 25 船 LNG 均绕行好望角，未再穿越地中海；此前 2025 年 11 月 1 日至 2026 年 2 月 16 日的 11 船货曾通过地中海和苏伊士运河。变化发生在 3 月 3 日 Arctic Metagaz 号在马耳他附近遇袭之后；Novatek 董事长 11 月 18 日称已签署对土耳其的供气合同，而运往土耳其的船货必须穿越地中海。

India Mandates Tougher Enclosed-Space Safety Procedures

India has ordered shipowners and managers to implement stricter enclosed-space entry procedures, covering crew training, atmospheric testing and emergency preparedness, implementing revised IMO recommendations adopted in June 2025. Companies must maintain an enclosed-space register for each ship, entry permits must not exceed eight hours, single-person entry is prohibited, and personnel entering enclosed spaces must carry personal gas detectors.
